# mapbox completion

1 command. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox completion

Print a shell completion script for `mapbox`

Print a completion script for one shell on stdout.

The script is generated from this binary's own command tree, so it completes exactly the services, operations and flags this build has — nothing is maintained by hand and nothing can fall behind a spec sync. It completes command and flag names; values such as style ids or usernames are not completed, since that would mean a request and a token mid-keystroke.

Nothing is written to disk: redirect it where your shell looks, or source it directly. `--output` does not apply — the script is the result.

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shell` | `SHELL` | yes | string | `bash`, `zsh`, `fish`, `powershell` | The shell to generate for. |

```sh
mapbox completion bash
```
